evidence: Built a requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md (the brief tells the agent to follow the rules file) against all 45 criteria (2 gate, 33 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Coverage is broad and mostly strong: one-stage moves/skips (hro_move_one_stage), bottom arrival (hro_arrive_bottom), manual order shared (hro_reorder), reject reason/rejected-from (hro_reject_reason), no reject from Hired (hro_reject_hired), reopen only to origin + reason cleared + undo restores reason (hro_reopen), interview places/reorder/freed place (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_undo_full, hro_bulk_places), optimistic move + put-back + reason + focus (hro_move_one_stage 'first look', hro_refused_put_back), role matrix (hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff), 401/403/404 (hro_anonymous, hro_refusal_status), stale 409 (hro_stale_refused), bulk order/all-or-none (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo restore/conflict/once/note-does-not-count (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict incl. B12/B14/B15, hro_undo_once), job/candidate intake and email rules and candidate linking (hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), notes (hro_notes; note draft per person in hro_pol_session_resume), Activity incl. reason, newest-first, filter, observer read, no refused lines (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), live board 15 s (hro_live_board) with open card/note/focus/scroll preserved (hro_pol_live_board), messages/Enter/Shift+Enter/plain text/empty+focused box (hro_msg_compose), failed send (hro_pol_failed_send), latest-30/earlier pages/place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), scrolled-up arrival (hro_unread_scrolled_up), per-person unread + total + sending counts as read via Mei's computed count (hro_unread_counts), seen incl. observer exclusion and HM (hro_seen), conversation access (hro_thread_access), drafts per conversation, reload, session end, other user on browser (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate view/wording/privacy (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private; 'signing in does not open one' is implicitly exercised by Lena's seeded unread 1 in Z), restart persistence, seeded order/note, no reseed (hro_restart), visual desktop craft (5 likert). Runtime-contract items (node /app/server.js, PORT, DB_PATH, cwd-independence, health route) are enforced by the template-controlled test.sh launch (env -i, PORT=3000, DB_PATH, non-/app copy when /app not writable) and SQLite/no-install/health-not-touching-DB are not browser-decidable shared runtime policy per REVIEW_POLICY 'Separate shared runtime policy from task-added technology requirements' - recorded as Note, not a gap. GAP 1 (the blocking one, P2): instruction.md:3 'when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who' and hireops_rules.md:77-80 'The person is told that the card was changed and by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is.' The only criterion is hro_stale_refused (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:208-209), fed by protocol C (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:33), which is a raw request replay from page.evaluate and accepts identification 'by name in the response or on screen'. No criterion drives a stale move through the UI, so the user-facing half of the requirement - the person being TOLD who changed it, and their board showing the card where it really is after a stale refusal - is ungraded. hro_refused_put_back (judge.toml:137) only covers the full-Interview refusal. MINOR GAPS (P3, reported for completeness, not individually blocking): (a) hireops_rules.md:99 undo refused if a card was 'reopened' since: hro_undo_conflict covers moved/re-ordered/rejected but no reopened-since leg (a reject+reopen that returns the card to the same bottom slot of the same stage would let a position-comparing undo check through ungraded). (b) instruction.md:7 'whether I am reading or halfway through a reply, never touch my draft or my cursor': draft/focus preservation is graded only at the newest message (hro_pol_live_thread, polish judge.toml:27-31); the scrolled-up case (hro_unread_scrolled_up, functional judge.toml:353) checks place/notice/unread but not a draft or focus held while scrolled up. (c) hireops_rules.md:166 'The observer opening a conversation never counts' is tested only for a staff message (U: Aud opens, still not seen), not for a candidate's message. (d) instruction.md:3 'If a move is refused ... tell me why' is graded for the full-Interview refusal only; skip/role refusals check only that nothing changed. These minor legs rely on the same mechanisms as graded siblings and the skill's flow false-positive plausibly absorbs (b)-(d).
counterexample: Broken app that passes: the server correctly versions cards and returns 409 {error:'stale', changedBy:'Mei Lin'} on an out-of-date move, but the board client ignores the body, shows a generic toast 'Move failed' (or nothing) and leaves the card in its optimistic, wrong column until the next poll. Protocol C replays the captured request via page.evaluate, the response names Mei Lin, F stays where Mei put it server-side, so hro_stale_refused = 1 and hro_refusal_status = 1, although the brief's explicit user-facing promise ('tell me who', 'their board shows the card where it really is') is never delivered and no criterion observes it.
suggested_fix: Add a UI leg to protocol C/hro_stale_refused (or a separate small row): pause the page's sync by route-aborting its polling/stream requests (as polish already does for sends), have Mei move F in an independent context, then move F through the page's ordinary controls, remove the interception, and require the refusal to name Mei Lin on screen and the card to be shown in its real stage and place; optionally add a reject+reopen leg to hro_undo_conflict.
